name: Kemendollár (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, light grey at the hoist and blue at the fly, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Kemendollár: a green and blue shield with a castle, a tree, a sheaf of grain and a wheel.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
